vb_textbox.text: Hi there! Hope my advice helps you collect more mushrooms.There are two important features in the game. The first one is that the gnomes will appear in pairs and they will be in set colours: orange & brown, blue & purple, red & yellow, green & pink. Their hat and position might change but it is irrelevant.The second feature is that each gnome in a pair will lead to a different forest. Orange, green, red and blue gnomes to the bright forest with a red basket, the others to the dark forest with a green basket. The aim is to find the forest that has the most mushrooms. The number of mushrooms in each forest constantly changes so you have to keep track of the forest that has the most mushrooms and try to go there. There will also be point multipliers (x1 and x5). Your goal is to collect as many mushrooms as you can, so focus more on the x5 round.Try to recognise which coloured gnome leads you to which forest.Good Luck!
